newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers rise with crude, rest of Europe stable.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers rise with crude, rest of Europe stable.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices gained around $2 a tonne as crude pushed up barges, while prices in the rest of Europe were mostly steady, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST bunkers gained about $2 to $92/93 fob. For once, the trading house that has dominated buying in the barge market, was a seller.
Some shipowners who had held out while prices were steadily urged higher needed to cover certain requirements by Wednesday, but total ARA demand was little more than 10,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices were little changed leaving barely any premium to Rotterdam prices.
Suppliers said this led to a number of enquiries, but fixture levels remained low.
Mediterranean prices were barely changed. Business in all ports was thin.

Saudi Aramco raised diesel by $3 in the Red Sea to $194 and by $2 in the Gulf to $212. Fuel oil prices will rise by $1 to $99 in the Red Sea, but will remain at $105 in the Gulf. The prices changes are effective from Thursday.
